name: derbysoft-connectivity-mcp
description: DerbySoft GO onboarding, certification status, connection profiles, and next steps through the GO certification MCP.

interface.shortDescription: GO onboarding, certification status and next steps.
interface.longDescription: Connect to the public GO certification MCP for account context, run status and connection profiles. Configure your own GO API key as the X-GO-Token HTTP header in your personal Codex MCP settings. GO_TOKEN remains available for environment-based setups.
defaultPrompt: Check my current GO certification status and next steps.
Show my GO connection profile and certification plan.
Explain the requirements I still need to meet for GO certification.
